coreAttributes.name: Unremarkable Mangosteen
coreAttributes.description: An exotic but otherwise unremarkable mangosteen. You can barely make out faint claw marks on on its rind from where a Manticore might have held it.
coreAttributes.applyEffects:
[##npc.incrementHealth(npc.getAttributeValue(ATTRIBUTE_HEALTH_MAXIMUM)/4)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(start)] to feel a lot healthier...

[#npc.addPotionEffect(ATTRIBUTE_MAJOR_PHYSIQUE, 10)] #IF(npc.getTailType()!=TAIL_TYPE_MANTICORE_TUSSY) [#npc.setTailType(TAIL_TYPE_MANTICORE_TUSSY)] #ENDIF

useDescriptions.selfUse: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(bite)] the bitter rind and quickly [npc.verb(spit)] it out, leaving [npc.herHim] with the sweet and tangy insides that [npc.herHim] quickly [npc.verb(devour)] after which a delicate floral flavor lingers in [npc.her] mouth.
useDescriptions.otherUse: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(bites)] the bitter rind and quickly [npc.verb(spits)] it out, leaving [npc.herHim] with the sweet and tangy insides, before bringing it up to [npc2.namePos] [npc2.lips] and getting [npc2.herHim] to eat it. Quickly devouring it, [npc2.name] is left with the delicate floral taste filling [npc2.her] mouth.
